sec.title: Batch 100 Forensic Milestone
sec.p: Batch 100 marks a monumental milestone—surpassing **1,930 canonical mystery broadcasts resolved, dated, committed to main, deployed to edge workers, and fully documented across 104 archival dispatches**: 2 legendary audition transcriptions of ***The Adventures of Superman*** starring Bud Collyer as Clark Kent and the Man of Steel detailing the destruction of the planet Krypton and his arrival on Earth (1940), New York Yankees icon Joe DiMaggio discussing hitting streaks, retirement, and pennant races with Leo Durocher and Laraine Day on ***Double Play*** (1953), Groucho and Chico Marx starring in their rare 1933 Esso radio series *Flywheel, Shyster, and Flywheel* featuring guest Bing Crosby, jazz bandleader Charlie Barnet teaming up with songstress Peggy King on 'Lonesome Road' (1950), MGM's 1934 radio promotional drama preview for *The Barretts of Wimpole Street* starring Norma Shearer and Fredric March, Bing Crosby performing for Navy sailors on ***Music on Deck*** (1952), wartime merchant sailors in combat on ***Heroes of the Merchant Marine*** (1943), early radio pioneers Billy Jones & Ernie Hare celebrating the New Deal as ***The Happiness Boys*** (1933), and 3 historical frontier dramatizations on ***Frontier Fighters*** (1935).
